Stop.description: typefully-draft-queue: queues any content output as a Typefully draft for scheduling
notion-content-archive: saves the session output to a Notion content archive database
claude-design-output-to-notion: saves design prompt output (decks, carousels, one-pagers) to a Notion page
slack-ping-on-stop: sends a Slack ping when a content generation task finishes

PostToolUse.description: linear-ticket-from-brief: creates a Linear ticket from a content brief or task description when a file or doc tool is used
